description: This file defines an Android Activity named FragmentStack which manages a stack of fragments dynamically, allowing addition and removal of fragments on a stack-like interface. It also includes an inner Fragment class CountingFragment that displays its own instance number.

classes.name: FragmentStack
classes.description: Main activity managing a stack of fragments with UI buttons to add or remove fragments.

classes.name: CountingFragment
classes.description: Inner static fragment class that displays its assigned number in a TextView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons for fragment management, and adds the initial fragment.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current stack level to restore state after configuration changes.

methods.name: addFragmentToStack
methods.description: Creates and adds a new CountingFragment to the activity's view, pushing it onto the back stack.

methods.name: CountingFragment.newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CountingFragment with a supplied number argument.

methods.name: CountingFragment.onCreate
methods.description: Retrieves its assigned number from arguments during creation.

methods.name: CountingFragment.onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the fragment's UI, displaying its number in a TextView with a background drawable.
